Use case: productivity-visual. REGENERATE this attached second pitch-deck slide as a clearly revised polished professional 16:9 landscape slide. Reference is the approved general layout: left scam progression timeline, right user-challenge text. White background, dark ink sans-serif, restrained orange highlights, clean native presentation aesthetic, no glossy textures. IMPORTANT REQUIRED CHANGES: Remove existing "02 / THE PROBLEM" eyebrow and old huge heading. New exact title "The Problem", centered at top, PowerPoint-equivalent 54pt font, bold. Directly below centered main problem definition at PowerPoint-equivalent 32pt font, regular/medium weight, exactly "Financial scams unfold across conversations and payment requests, leaving users to judge risk with incomplete context." Split into two balanced lines. Maintain clear 54pt vs 32pt hierarchy; header not oversized, reasonable top margins. Remove ENTIRE bottom orange strip and its conclusion, including lightbulb. No new bottom banner. Remove ALL THREE icons in the right section, including their circles; no screens, clock, bell, warning icons, pictograms, emojis or other decorative icons anywhere on right. Replace right icon space with aligned text. Use recovered room to make content comfortably readable, substantial and full, not empty, not crowded.
Main body below definition: left 56% three vertical timeline stages with simple outlined number circles 01 02 03 and thin vertical rail, restrained structured text panels, orange curved dotted arrow between second and third panels to suggest progression. Right 44% text-only section heading "Why the user needs help", three left-aligned challenge headings and fuller body text, subtle horizontal rules. Exact left stage content:
"BUILD TRUST"
"Your investment balance is ready."
"A credible-sounding claim establishes trust before any payment is requested."
"ADD A PAYMENT CONDITION"
"Pay a processing fee to withdraw."
"Access to the promised funds now depends on sending more money."
"CREATE URGENCY"
"Transfer now to avoid losing access."
"Pressure to act reduces the time available to verify the claim."
Exact right text:
"Fragmented context"
"Messages, calls and payment requests can sit on different screens. The user must connect earlier claims with the latest requested action."
"Pressure to act"
"A promised benefit becomes tied to an urgent payment. The user has little time to check the sender or confirm the reason for the fee."
"Warning fatigue"
"Repeated alerts with vague reasons can be easy to dismiss. A useful warning must identify the specific concern and the next verification step."
Small restrained footer exact "Sachet · Team ANKOR" on left and "RAKSHAM · IIT Delhi | Statement 2" on right. No fabricated stats, no member names, no scenario label, no extra slogan or extra text, no bottom orange strip, no icons on right. High resolution readable accurate text.
VARIANT A: Closest to reference. Three crisp rounded rectangular left cards, middle card light orange fill and thin orange border, neutral outer border around the right text-only panel, vertical thin rules between its three sections. Align all card edges and text baselines. Thin gray horizontal rule under definition. Body panels occupy most of remaining height; visually balanced.
